decisions.title: AGPL-3.0 for first-party NeuronAI (docs/metadata)
decisions.content:
Problem: Need open-source distribution with stronger protection against closed network/SaaS freeriding than a prior permissive license.
Decision: First-party NeuronAI is AGPL-3.0 (LICENSE, package.json metadata, docs). NOTICE removed. Brand remains under TRADEMARK.md; inbound contributions AGPL with no CLA.
Reason: AGPL remains OSI open source; network use of modified versions typically requires offering corresponding source; trademark policy stays separate from the code license.

decisions.title: Ask-before-remember UX: autoSave true + Yes/No instead of Save|Edit|Ignore
decisions.content:
Problem: Save|Edit|Ignore felt like fake unclickable buttons; autoSave defaulted false; contextMaxTokens confused users in neuron.config.json.
Decision: Default memory.autoSave=true. Default privacy.mode stays suggest (ask before writing). User-facing copy is “Should I remember this?” with Yes / Yes+rephrase / No (not Save|Edit|Ignore). contextMaxTokens = max ranked memory tokens injected per agent turn (default 3000); omit from generated neuron.config.json so schema default applies.
Reason: Clearer consent language, saving is enabled by default but still confirms, leaner config for end users.
